The package also installs a valid ALPM hook under `/usr/share/libalpm/hooks`, which is appropriate for a tool that needs to run after package installations. All dependencies are legitimate Perl modules, and no network operations, file manipulations, or commands suggest malicious behavior.

There is no obfuscated code, unexpected downloads, or execution of external scripts. The maintainer-provided files (`needrestart.hook`) are installed in the correct location and do not appear to contain harmful content based on naming or context.
